value.rationale: The defect is in an invariant region used for mathematical well-posedness and as a domain for epidemic stability arguments. The paper’s own calibration makes the printed cap 43,800 times too small, and an explicit admissible boundary trajectory leaves immediately. Identifying and correcting an essential analytical precondition is substantively useful beyond checking a harmless typo.
residual_risks: This establishes neither actual epidemic predictions nor validity/invalidity of later theorems.

final_claim: Published bound E<=α_E/μ_E fails to be invariant if Λ_m/μ_m>1; the sharp uniform inward-pointing rectangular cap E<=α_EΛ_m/(μ_E μ_m) is required. Published Table 1 gives 43800 versus published cap 1 and explicit exiting boundary state E_dot=1/14.
limitations: Necessity refers to uniform inward pointing on the stated rectangle, not to all possible smaller invariant sets.
